concept: Helping someone just because they need it, not because you'll get something back
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character helps someone in need without expecting a reward, and feels good about it afterward
exercise.reflection_prompt: Why did helping feel good, even without getting anything back?
exercise.practice: Student names one way they could help someone this week

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, realistic act of help
